messages:
Tom (AE): Atlas ready to sign but procurement wants HSM attestation + EU residency clause. Need quick path for PO ingestion and DocuSign routing.
Isha (Legal): They'll keep pushing 30-day SLA cure. Recommend counter with 45 days and accept residency with DPA exhibit. Will tweak indemnity.
Diego (Finance): AP needs single-line JSON orderform and PO number field. Net30 acceptable if invoice_email is invoices@atlas.co. Need remit-to and VAT.
Rae (SE): HSM: Dedicated = BYOK, Hosted = Thales managed. We can supply an attestation letter on letterhead in ~3 business days. If they need module certs, allow 7-10 bd. Include attestation_pending flag in orderform.
Atlas Procurement: Provide the one-line JSON and confirm whether keys remain under our control. Region must be eu-west-2 and SLA 99.9 mandatory.
Tom (AE): Example JSON to paste into AP: {"customer":"Atlas Inc","po_number":"<PO>","sku":"RD-DED","region":"eu-west-2","qty":"2","monthly_price":"60000","billing_contact":"invoices@atlas.co","support_sla":"99.9","kms_mode":"BYOK|vendor-hsm","attestation_pending":"true"}
Isha (Legal): Uploading MSA patch now and will add DPA exhibit + subproc list. esign-bot: new contract MSA_atlas_v2.pdf uploaded by @Isha.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope ready once legal signs off; route to legal@redwood.com and finance@redwood.com for countersign.
Diego (Finance): After PO + JSON received, send invoices to invoices@atlas.co and cc finance@redwood.com. I'll set Net30 and add VAT on the billing record.
Tom (AE): Plan: Isha finalizes MSA/DPA today, I send JSON + DocuSign, Diego completes billing after PO. Will update when envelope sends. :thumbsup:
